control.scope: Visible correct means the healthy top class, leaf pass, enabled class, and familiar distance; low score or margin may still show only a provisional candidate. Photo quality/blur gates and manual user crop choice are outside this graph-level count.

candidate.scope: Visible correct means the healthy top class, leaf pass, enabled class, and familiar distance; low score or margin may still show only a provisional candidate. Photo quality/blur gates and manual user crop choice are outside this graph-level count.

limitations: Fourteen Healthy-only field photos are too few for disease accuracy claims.
The dataset-provided Healthy label has not been independently expert reviewed.
The older PlantDoc external benchmark was reused for non-regression and is not a fresh blind field test.
